name: treat burst
ingredients_raw: Dark choco filling (38%) [sugar, refined palm oil, cocoa solids, emulsifier [322 (i)], iodised salt and artificial (vanillin) flavoring substances], refined wheat flour (maida), interesterified vegetable fat, sugar, invert sugar syrup, liquid glucose, raising agents [503(ii), 500(ii) & 450(i)], cocoa solids (0.7%), butter, iodised salt, milk solids, colour (150d), emulsifiers [322(i) & 471], and artificial (milky cocoa & vanilla) & nature identical flavouring substances.
